facts.text: The hotel is in Rome's Prati district, a few steps from St. Peter's and Piazza di Spagna.
facts.excerpt: Located in the charming Prati district, a few steps from St. Peter’s and Piazza di Spagna

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Spanish Steps, the Vatican and the Tiber River.
facts.excerpt: Just a short walk from the Spanish Steps, the Vatican, and the Tiber River, Le Méridien Visconti Rome is a central hotel in the heart of the Eternal City.

facts.text: The interior design, from lighting to furnishings, is a contemporary interpretation of mid-century modernism.
facts.excerpt: From the lighting to the furnishings, the interior design is a contemporary interpretation of mid-century modernism.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Hotel rooms in Rome with floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Roman architectural materials inspire the guest rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Celebrated Roman architectural materials inspire the 242 timeless guest rooms and hotel suites at Le Méridien Visconti Rome.

facts.text: The Terrace Suites have a living room, a marble bathroom with a bathtub and separate shower, and a private terrace overlooking Rome's rooftops.
facts.excerpt: a refined living room, an elegant bedroom, large marble bathroom featuring both a bathtub and a separate shower, and a private terrace from which to admire the enchanting view over Rome’s rooftops.

facts.text: The Grand Suite has a terrace with a private hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Our Grand Suite, features 80 square meters of elegantly designed indoor space and a 95 square meters terrace with a private hot tub

facts.text: The Grand Suite lounge has a record player for listening to vinyl records.
facts.excerpt: The advanced technology is seamlessly integrated with a record player in the room, offering guests to indulge in the timeless experience of listening to vinyl records..

facts.text: From the Grand Suite terrace guests can watch the sun rise over Castel Sant'Angelo.
facts.excerpt: Whether you are watching the sun rise over Castel Sant'Angelo or enjoying the golden glow of sunset

facts.text: The Top Suite is inspired by designs of the 1950s and 1960s and has a green terrace with a private hot tub and views of the city's rooftops.
facts.excerpt: The suite also features an immense green terrace, providing a breathtaking view of the city's rooftops and architecture, complete with a private hot tub.

facts.text: The Top Suite terrace has an outdoor shower and a bar area.
facts.excerpt: An elegant shower is nestled in one corner, offering a refreshing outdoor experience as you bask in the gentle morning light. The stylish bar area is perfectly positioned for savoring a fine wine or prosecco

facts.text: Paparazzo Bar & Rooftop is a rooftop cocktail bar inspired by the 1960s Dolce Vita, with views over the city.
facts.excerpt: Perched above the city, Paparazzo Bar & Rooftop is a refined destination where Rome’s timeless charm meets contemporary elegance. Inspired by the glamour of the 1960s Dolce Vita

facts.text: Longitude 12 Bistrot & Jardin is a coffee house by day and a restaurant by evening, serving Italian flavors in an indoor garden setting.
facts.excerpt: Longitude 12 Bistrot & Jardin is a bright coffee house by day and a cozy downtown Rome restaurant by evening, serving Italian flavors in a fresh indoor garden setting.

facts.text: Guests can rent e-bikes directly from the hotel to explore Rome.
facts.excerpt: Our guests can now rent e-bikes directly from the hotel: a sustainable and convenient way to explore Rome in total freedom.

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified

facts.text: The hotel has a complimentary fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Open 24/7 and complimentary, our fitness center offers the perfect space to stay healthy in Rome.

facts.text: The hotel accepts small pets.
facts.excerpt: The hotel accepts small pets.

facts.text: The hotel has a conference center with nine high-tech meeting rooms.
facts.excerpt: also offers a multifunctional conference center with 9 high-tech meeting rooms

facts.text: Guests receive reusable bottles made from recycled plastic that they can refill at hotel dispensers or at Rome's nasoni fountains.
facts.excerpt: You can refill them at the dispensers in the hotel or at the iconic Roman “nasoni” fountains throughout the city.

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Le Méridien Visconti Rome do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Breakfast at Latitude 41 Restaurant is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Latitude 41 Restaurant for a fee.

facts.text: Parking is off-site valet parking.
facts.excerpt: Off-site valet parking is available at Le Méridien Visconti Rome.
